title: Events are delivered to on() listeners
description: Verifies that events from the shell arrive at registered on() callbacks and stop when unsubscribed.
given: A client with an on() listener registered
when: An event message arrives from the shell
then: The callback receives the event payload; after unsubscribe, subsequent events do not reach it
